description: Research Zendesk onboarding journeys across Gmail and browser-based Gong, Salesforce and View 360, then produce a validated import JSON for the Onboarding Wins app.

defaultPrompt: Analyze this Zendesk onboarding account and return the validated Onboarding Wins import JSON.
Find evidence-backed retention, implementation, adoption, expansion and CSQL wins across Gmail and authorized browser sessions.
Normalize ARR, agents, subscription, add-ons, timeline and sources, then produce JSON ready for the Onboarding Wins app.
interface.longDescription: Created by Adrián Trejo for  the Zendesk Onboarding Customer Success team. Collect evidence from Gmail and the local Chrome session, normalize ARR and customer metrics, identify only evidence-backed wins and CSQLs, and output the canonical JSON consumed by the Onboarding Wins app.

name: onboarding-wins
